cases.query: I have a model.pt file. How do I serve it on Triton?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Explain the TorchScript platform form, model repository layout, and write a minimal config.pbtxt.

cases.query: Serve this scripted ResNet50 .pt on Triton with dynamic batching.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Build a config.pbtxt with platform: pytorch_libtorch, max_batch_size, dynamic_batching block, instance_group KIND_GPU.

cases.query: I built a .pt2 using torch.export + aoti_compile_and_package. Serve it.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Explain backend: pytorch + platform: torch_aoti, device-baked warning, instance_group matching export device.

cases.query: I have model.pt2 exported on CPU. Deploy it.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Config with torch_aoti + KIND_CPU. Warn that archive is CPU-only.

cases.query: Export a PyTorch model to PT2 for GPU serving on Triton.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Give the torch.export + Dim recipe with .cuda() on model and sample, package, and deploy with KIND_GPU.

cases.query: Write a config.pbtxt for a PyTorch model that takes two FP32 tensors.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Produce a complete config with INPUT__0, INPUT__1, OUTPUT__0 or forward-arg names.

cases.query: Should I use TorchScript or PT2 for my new model?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Explain: PT2 is the forward path if torch.export works for the model; TorchScript is legacy but widely compatible.

cases.query: backend: pytorch or platform: pytorch_libtorch?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Explain the three forms and when each applies.

cases.query: Deploy a PyTorch model using the Python runtime path with model.py.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Explain backend: pytorch + runtime: model.py form, cite L0_pytorch_python_runtime example.

cases.query: Can I name my TorchScript file something other than model.pt?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Yes, set default_model_filename in config.pbtxt.

cases.query: I want my PT2 archive called resnet50.pt2 not model.pt2.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. default_model_filename: "resnet50.pt2".

cases.query: config.pbtxt has TYPE_BF16 and Triton says unsupported datatype. Fix.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Explain BF16 is not supported by PyTorch backend. Options: cast to FP16/FP32, use ONNX backend, or TensorRT.

cases.query: My PT2 model needs BF16. Server rejects it with Unsupported datatype TYPE_BF16.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Same recommendation: cast or switch backend.

cases.query: Can I serve an FP8 PyTorch model on Triton?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. No. FP8 is not supported in the PyTorch backend. Suggest TensorRT.

cases.query: My model has UINT32 inputs. Triton logs unsupported datatype TYPE_UINT32.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Cast to INT64 or switch to ONNX backend. Cite L0_libtorch_io_types.

cases.query: The docs say FP16 is blank for PyTorch. Can I use it?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. FP16 is supported by both `pytorch_libtorch` and `torch_aoti` despite the docs table being stale. Cite libtorch_utils.cc.

cases.query: Triton logs: unable to find '/models/foo/1/model.pt' for model instance 'foo'.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Place model.pt at 1/model.pt or set default_model_filename.

cases.query: Triton: PyTorch inductor model file "..." is unreachable or inaccessible.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. PT2 file missing. Place model.pt2 at 1/model.pt2 or set default_model_filename.

cases.query: PT2 won't load: configuration expects 1 inputs, but model expects 2 inputs.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Match input count in config.pbtxt to the exported call spec. Account for control, state, batch inputs separately.

cases.query: Triton says Incorrect device passed to aoti_runner_cpu.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. PT2 archive was exported on wrong device. Re-export on target device.

cases.query: Triton: failed to load model 'foo': TorchScript archive error.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Rebuild in matching PyTorch version container. Check for opset drift.

cases.query: Triton: 'OUTPUT__0' is a scalar which is not supported.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Wrap return with torch.tensor(...).

cases.query: Multiple inputs of kind DictType were detected.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Only one Dict[str, Tensor] input allowed. Collapse or use Tensor-only inputs.

cases.query: An input of type 'List[int]' was detected in the model.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Only Tensor and Dict[str, Tensor] inputs are supported. Refactor forward().

cases.query: PyTorch model 'rnn' is using sequence batching with state but not all inputs and outputs follow the <name>__<index> naming convention.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Rename every input and output to <name>__<index>. Required for stateful sequence batching.

cases.query: PT2: Sequence control input must be addressed using ordinal INPUT__<index>.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Switch sequence control and state names to INPUT__<i> / OUTPUT__<i>.

cases.query: Triton: Failed to dlopen MODEL_INIT_LIBRARY "/models/foo/1/libinit.so".
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Check file exists, architecture matches, ldd for missing deps.

cases.query: MODEL_INIT_LIBRARY does not export 'triton_pytorch_model_init'.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Library must export extern "C" void triton_pytorch_model_init(const char*, int). Add the symbol and rebuild.

cases.query: model configuration must contain at least one input, none were specified.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Add input [ { ... } ] block to config.pbtxt.

cases.query: model configuration must contain at least one output.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Add output [ { ... } ] block to config.pbtxt.

cases.query: Can I name my config inputs to match the forward() argument names?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Yes, FORWARD_ARGUMENT is the first resolver tried. Explain the 3 rules.

cases.query: What's the INPUT__0 convention?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. NAMED_INDEX: <name>__<integer>, double underscore delimiter.

cases.query: What do I name inputs in a PT2 config.pbtxt?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Either call-spec names (ARGS[0], KWARGS[k]) or ordinals (INPUT__0). Both work.

cases.query: My PT2 model returns one Tensor. What's the output name?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. RESULT or OUTPUT__0. Both resolve to the single tensor.

cases.query: My TorchScript model loaded READY but gives wrong results. Names are 'image' and 'mask' but model says forward(mask, image).
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Strict config ordering silently maps by position. Rename to INPUT__0 / INPUT__1 or match forward() exactly in the right order.

cases.query: How do I enable CUDA cache cleaning on TorchScript?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. parameters { key: "ENABLE_CACHE_CLEANING" value { string_value: "true" } }.

cases.query: Cache cleaning on a PT2 model.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. parameters { key: "CACHE_CLEANING_ENABLED" value { string_value: "true" } }. Note the different name versus TorchScript.

cases.query: How do I limit PyTorch to 4 threads per model?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Set INTRA_OP_THREAD_COUNT but warn it is process-global; first model to load wins.

cases.query: What does INFERENCE_MODE do?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Guards execution with c10::InferenceMode, strictly stronger than NoGrad. Default true.

cases.query: Enable weight sharing across instances.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. ENABLE_WEIGHT_SHARING true. Warn: not compatible with sequence batching.

cases.query: Disable cuDNN for reproducibility.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. DISABLE_CUDNN true.

cases.query: ENABLE_JIT_PROFILING false, will Triton force true?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. No. The flag is tri-state: unset means libtorch default, false means explicitly off.

cases.query: Load external embedding weights before my PT2 loads.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Use MODEL_INIT_LIBRARY. Provide stub .so example with triton_pytorch_model_init.

cases.query: My PT2 fails when batch > 1. What's wrong?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Archive was exported without torch.export.Dim on batch. Re-export with dynamic batch dim >= max_batch_size.

cases.query: torch.export says: You marked batch as dynamic but your code specialized it to constant 1.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Sample input had batch=1. Use batch > 1 sample (e.g. torch.randn(2, ...)) so export does not specialize.

cases.query: Does PT2 work on RHEL?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. No. AOT Inductor not available on RHEL manylinux builds as of 26.10.

cases.query: Can I use TYPE_STRING on a PT2 model?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. No. AOT Inductor is tensor-only. Use TorchScript for 1-D List[str], or ONNX.

cases.query: TYPE_STRING CORRID in sequence batching on PT2.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Not supported. Use TYPE_INT32 or TYPE_INT64 for CONTROL_SEQUENCE_CORRID on PT2.

cases.query: Set up sequence batching with state on TorchScript.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Use NAMED_INDEX for every input/output, sequence_batching block, control_input block.

cases.query: How do I do implicit-state sequence batching on PT2?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Explain from code-comment spec: forward accepts control+state as regular args, returns new state. Ordinal naming required. Use INT64 CORRID.

cases.query: Multi-GPU PyTorch model. How do I place it?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. KIND_MODEL so the model's own .to(device) wins. Warn about three behavioral differences from KIND_GPU.

cases.query: Triton PyTorch is slow under load.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Backend is BLOCKING. Add more instances in instance_group, not threads per instance.

cases.query: First TorchScript request is slow.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. JIT compiles on first invocation. Add model_warmup with representative shapes.

cases.query: I set INTRA_OP_THREAD_COUNT = 4 on one model and 8 on another. Why doesn't the second one apply?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Process-global via std::call_once. First model to load wins.

cases.query: Where are PyTorch inference metrics?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Standard Triton /metrics on port 8002. Nothing PyTorch-specific.

cases.query: I pip install torch in tritonserver container and it doesn't match libtorch.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. tritonserver container ships libtorch but not Python torch. Build artifacts in nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:26.10-py3 for ABI match.

cases.query: Show me a curl inference request for a PyTorch model.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Provide KFServing v2 JSON POST to /v2/models/<name>/infer.

cases.query: Send a large tensor via binary extension.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Set Inference-Header-Content-Length and send tensor bytes after the JSON header.

cases.query: I have a custom TorchScript op in libmycustom.so.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. LD_PRELOAD the library when launching tritonserver with LD_LIBRARY_PATH including /opt/tritonserver/backends/pytorch.

cases.query: Why do my int8 traced-model values overflow when converted to int32 on GPU?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Known upstream bug (pytorch/pytorch#66930). Cite 26.10 release notes. Suggest scripting instead of tracing or casting before serve.

cases.query: I have a model.onnx. How do I serve on Triton?
cases.expected_outcome: Do not use this skill. Point to triton-onnx-model-repository.

cases.query: I have a model.plan from trtexec. How do I serve?
cases.expected_outcome: Do not use this skill. Point to triton-tensorrt-model-repository.

cases.query: Train a PyTorch model on 8 GPUs.
cases.expected_outcome: Do not use this skill. This is training, not inference serving.

cases.query: Deploy my model with TorchServe.
cases.expected_outcome: Do not use this skill. Different product. Point to TorchServe docs.

cases.query: Serve Llama-3 with vLLM via Dynamo.
cases.expected_outcome: Do not use this skill. Dynamo deployment path, different skill.

cases.query: Load a TensorFlow SavedModel.
cases.expected_outcome: Do not use this skill. TensorFlow backend, different skill.

cases.query: How do I use torch.nn.Linear?
cases.expected_outcome: Do not use this skill. General PyTorch API question, not Triton deployment.

cases.query: My app loads a model.pt file directly with torch.load. It's slow.
cases.expected_outcome: Do not use this skill. User is not deploying on Triton. Point to PyTorch optimization docs.

cases.query: Package my .pt for PyTorch Mobile.
cases.expected_outcome: Do not use this skill. Mobile deployment, not Triton.

cases.query: I used torch.save to create a .pt2 file.
cases.expected_outcome: Clarify. torch.save does not produce a PT2 archive. PT2 is from torch._inductor.aoti_compile_and_package. If the user then wants to serve the result, use this skill.

cases.query: TRT-LLM PyTorch backend. Deploy Qwen2.5-VL.
cases.expected_outcome: Do not use this skill. TRT-LLM has its own PyTorch flavor. Point to TRT-LLM / Dynamo skills.

cases.query: I set up a Flask server with torch model inference.
cases.expected_outcome: Do not use this skill unless user wants to migrate to Triton. If asked about Triton migration, use the skill.

cases.query: Export my PyTorch model to ONNX and serve.
cases.expected_outcome: Do not use this skill. Point to triton-onnx-model-repository after the user has the .onnx file.

cases.query: I have this .pt file, please help.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. The `.pt` extension is the TorchScript convention for Triton; confirm context with the user and proceed with the skill workflow.

cases.query: Deploy my LibTorch model.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. LibTorch model = TorchScript. Point to platform: pytorch_libtorch.

cases.query: Serve my AOTI model.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. AOTI = AOT Inductor = PT2 archive = torch_aoti platform.

cases.query: I have a scripted module I need to deploy.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. torch.jit.script output served via platform: pytorch_libtorch.

cases.query: Deploy my inductor compiled package.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. PT2 archive. Use backend: pytorch + platform: torch_aoti.

cases.query: Generate a model config for my PyTorch model.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. config.pbtxt generation is one of the core triggers.

cases.query: Help me set up a model serving pipeline.
cases.expected_outcome: Clarify. Ask which backend/file type. If PyTorch, use the skill.

cases.query: I want to deploy PyTorch models.
cases.expected_outcome: Clarify. Ask whether deployment target is Triton. If Triton, use the skill.

cases.query: Write a Triton config.pbtxt.
cases.expected_outcome: Clarify. Ask backend. If PyTorch, use the skill.

cases.query: I have a .pt file from a tutorial.
cases.expected_outcome: Clarify. Confirm it's a TorchScript archive and not a raw state_dict. If TorchScript, use the skill.

cases.query: Why is Triton not filling in my PyTorch model's config.pbtxt automatically?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Explain that the PyTorch backend does not support auto-complete on either platform. Cite the 26.10 release notes and point to writing config.pbtxt by declaring every input, output, datatype, and shape explicitly.

cases.query: Do I need --disable-auto-complete-config when running PyTorch on Triton?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Recommended because the backend never auto-completes anyway; the flag silences the startup warning.

cases.query: Triton returns: PyTorch execute failure: output must be of type Tensor or List[str], received List[Tensor]
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. The TorchScript model returns a Python list of tensors. Return a Tuple of Tensors instead, or a single Tensor.

cases.query: My TorchScript model loaded READY but inference returns numbers that look swapped. No error in the server log.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Classic STRICT_CONFIG_ORDERING fallback: config input names match neither forward() args nor <name>__<index>, so the backend maps by position silently. Rename every input to INPUT__0 / INPUT__1 in order and re-deploy.

cases.query: I named my inputs after the forward() args but the outputs still look wrong.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Check that the config input order matches the forward() arg order. FORWARD_ARGUMENT only matches by name when every name hits; if one is off, the resolver falls back. Also confirm outputs use <name>__<index> because outputs cannot use FORWARD_ARGUMENT.

cases.query: I want to use torch.compile with my PyTorch model served on Triton. How?
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Use the Python runtime path: backend: pytorch + runtime: model.py in config.pbtxt. The TORCH_COMPILE_OPTIONAL_PARAMETERS parameter takes JSON of torch.compile kwargs.

cases.query: Serve my multi-GPU PyTorch model where the model itself calls .to('cuda:1').
cases.expected_outcome: Use the skill. Use instance_group kind: KIND_MODEL so the backend does not override device placement. Call out the three KIND_MODEL behavioral differences: inputs land on CPU, output path forces cudaStreamSynchronize, inputs collected on one stream while outputs span all streams.
